context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 user-reported bugs have been verified as FIXED. The app is working correctly.

bug_1_service_orders_in_dropdown.evidence: OS dropdown shows all 3 service orders from database: '2602-12 - Constellation', '2602-14 - Constellation - Teste Hidrostatico', 'TEST-99 - Test Client'. Native HTML <select> element works correctly on web.

bug_2_calendar_for_dates.evidence: Native HTML <input type='date'> elements found in create-report and edit-report pages. Calendar picker appears when clicking date fields. Dates display in mm/dd/yyyy format.

bug_3_report_creation_success.evidence: Created report successfully. Alert shows 'Relatório de Serviço criado com sucesso!' and redirects to dashboard. New report appears in dashboard list.

bug_4_dynamic_section_numbering.evidence: Sections numbered 1-4 by default. When EQUIPAMENTOS disabled, numbering updates: OBJETIVO becomes '2.' (was '3.'), DESCRIÇÃO DOS SERVIÇOS becomes '3.' (was '4.'). Subsections also renumber correctly (3.1, 3.1.1 etc).

bug_5_fotos_photo_only_subsections.evidence: FOTOS subsections (4.1.1 and 4.2.1) found with 'Adicionar Foto' buttons. isPhotoOnlySection() function checks for keys ending in '_photos' or containing 'fotos'. Photo grid renders with caption inputs. Code verified in edit-report.tsx lines 30, 232-286, 421-428, 431-441.
